owner_information: On 2026-10-23 the owner chose the QualX3 distribution approach for the five inherited table scopes. See scientific_data_policy in deploy/distribution.json. Earlier findings and hashes remain unchanged; separate third-party data grants have not been verified. Removed/replaced artwork/manual originals and excluded examples/CIF remain outside this decision.

decisions.windows_formal_distribution: MinGW only; MSVC development validation retained
decisions.scientific_tables: Follow the scoped upstream policy recorded in deploy/distribution.json; preserve original references, compilation-copyright qualifications and preferred sources without claiming new third-party grants.

upstream_official_reference_scope: Official CNR pages link to the QualX3 GitHub releases. This corroborates repository provenance, not an asset-specific grant or permission for externally authored tables.

documentation_replacement.scope: All 17 user manual pages independently authored from current product contracts and implementation. Old document branding and unused MathJax setup removed; no old screenshots or measured examples delivered.
documentation_replacement.original_status: No new grant asserted. Original text and removed assets remain recoverable only from the recorded Git revision, outside current manual delivery.
documentation_replacement.copyright: Copyright (C) 2026 QualPF contributors, to the extent applicable rights exist
documentation_replacement.qualifications: Bibliographic facts, upstream attribution and third-party notices remain. No scientific table, reference fixture, product behavior or historical acceptance record is replaced.
documentation_replacement.bibliography_scope: 27 numbered entries from the first three notes consolidated into 23 reference groups, retaining shared sources once. Fast and performance notes have no additional numbered bibliography. Notes are not redistributed; only bibliographic facts and independently written context enter the manual.

mingw_vendor_archive.source_binding: Binary and vendor build-info match verified. All ten named patches and upstream archives are supplied; exact resolved source recipe commit remains unrecorded. Workflow checks out mutable develop; public historic run query returned no retained run.
mingw_vendor_archive.required_information: Coverage of the actual three GCC DLLs by complete corresponding source, patches and a usable build recipe, or an applicable supplier source package. The resolved vendor commit or original logs can establish this, but they are not mandatory evidence formats. Independently verified public materials are acceptable; a controlled rebuild is a fallback when coverage cannot otherwise be established.
mingw_vendor_archive.owner_original_records: Unavailable; owner confirmed no original source snapshot or build log. Public evidence has not established the resolved vendor recipe commit.

header_source_followup.remaining_configuration_header: Actual c++config.h, its GNU template, configure inputs and source version/date are retained; factory configure probes were not independently rerun.
header_source_followup.source_scope: Full GNU GCC archive, ten named patches, complete candidate build scripts, MinGW-w64 v11 source and actual SDK C++/target headers are supplied offline.
header_source_followup.qualification: The candidate script commit is not represented as the factory commit. The recipe downloads a mutable v11 branch; the exact original branch checkout and complete runtime source/configuration correspondence remain unverified. No bit-identical rebuild claim.

ifw_container.source_binding: PE imports and embedded markers identify dependencies but do not exclude a static MSVC CRT or attest complete source/build inputs.
ifw_container.required_information: Coverage of the actual embedded Qt/static dependency sources and applicable build/link inputs, plus CRT identification and redistribution basis. Existing supplier sources/terms and independently verified recipes may establish coverage without private factory logs; assess any source exception on its actual terms rather than inferring it from imports. A controlled build is an alternative.
ifw_container.owner_original_records: Unavailable; owner confirmed no static dependency/build/link or CRT-origin records.

static_dependency_followup.stale_generic_sdk_notice: 3RDPARTY lists LZMA SDK 9.20; source attribution identifies 9.38.beta. Original evidence remains unchanged.
static_dependency_followup.liblzma_license: 0BSD; other files in the XZ source archive keep their own terms
static_dependency_followup.qualification: Source defaults and embedded strings identify additional inputs but do not establish actual static build flags, all patches, or absence/redistribution terms of a static CRT.

upstream_comparison.windows_build: script/build_windows.cmd uses oneAPI/MSVC and Qt 6.8.1, so it does not attest the QualPF MinGW DLLs or the IFW container.
upstream_comparison.linux_packaging: script/build_appimage.sh uses linuxdeploy and appimagetool. Follow the same packaging mechanisms while checking actual container contents and keeping their source/notices.
upstream_comparison.upstream_ifw: CMakeLists.txt selects installed C:/Qt/QtIFW-4.8.1 and canonical root GPL; no IFW/static dependency rebuild recipe appears in the inspected scripts.
upstream_comparison.upstream_vc_runtime: deploy/Windows/installscript.qs executes vc_redist.x64.exe; QualPF MinGW formal delivery does not import this bootstrap.
upstream_comparison.public_evidence_limit: Only public tracked scripts/documentation and release asset metadata were checked. The asset list has no separate vendor runtime source bundle or factory logs. Upstream installer contents and private arrangements were not inspected.

adopted_procedure.basis: Follow the observed upstream packaging mechanism while retaining existing notices/source bundles and actual package checks. Complete independently verified source/build materials can resolve gaps; absence of private logs alone does not require rebuilding a toolchain.

appimage_runtime.qualifications: Original source/file terms retained; no blanket aports repository license inferred. Vendor build/source binding is distinct from a controlled rebuild.

normal_regressions.native_ubuntu_strict: 1/1 PASS in 4.79 seconds; not combined into a fresh 127-test claim

Complete GUI wizard, GNOME integration and a fresh MSVC lifecycle are not claimed. Private original fixtures stayed outside delivery. Subsequent helper/documentation commits do not relabel these artifacts.
